directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 30 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. Output is a volume rate. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油50型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成30 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成30 MPa。柴油50型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成30 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成30 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump. The picture shows Jet pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 30 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Its subject is workers guiding a concrete delivery hose on wall formwork. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump。画面是Jet pump。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油50型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成30 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成30 MPa。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this sheet. Main-unit weight is 3300 kg.
body.zh: 柴油50型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成30 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成30 MPa。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成柴油50型混凝土泵的铭牌。

body.en: On the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 30 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. Main-unit weight is 3300 kg. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³.
body.zh: 行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

question.en: What output does the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 柴油50型混凝土泵这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 30 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是30 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump.
answer.zh: 最大出口压力是30 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump.
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump画面里印出的数字。
